description: Fallback for game actions that have NO dedicated tool: corporations, crafting, drones, planets, contracts, ships, skills, DMs, pirate fights (FIGHT, FLEE) and anomalies (ANOMALY_*). Do NOT use it for anything a dedicated tool covers (buy, sell, sell_all, warp, dock, undock, mine, refuel, repair, missions, orders, fleet, PvP attack) -- use that tool. Pass the action name in UPPER_CASE as action. Unsure of the name: action=LIST_ACTIONS lists all names by group (group=... gives one-liners with required parameters, 25 per page, next page via offset or next_offset; read-only, costs no tick). Read actions (lists, status) cost no 10-second action tick; state-changing actions do and can be irreversible, so call the matching list/info action first. Parameters are passed flat or bundled in params. Available: the 239 orchestrator actions without a dedicated tool: ADVANCE, AMMO_BUY, ANALYZE_MARKET, ANOMALY_COMPLETE, ANOMALY_ENTER, ANOMALY_HACK, ANOMALY_LEAVE, ANOMALY_LIST, ANOMALY_SCAN, action.description: Required. Action name in UPPER_CASE, e.g. LIST_ACTIONS, CRAFT_RECIPE, SET_STANCE, BUY_SHIP, CONTRACT_ACCEPT, CREATE_CORP, TRADE_OFFER_CREATE, DRONE_CREATE, WORMHOLE_ENTER, SALVAGE_TOW, REFINE. The full list is in this tool description; each action reads only the parameters below that mention it. Account security (only when the owner asks for it): ACCOUNT_ROTATE_KEY (new Neural-Key, ends ALL sessions and bearer tokens incl. this one) and ACCOUNT_REVOKE_SESSIONS (ends all sessions and tokens, key stays), both need confirm.

all.description: For MODULE_REPAIR — 1 = repair all damaged modules.

amount.description: Amount in CWM or units (integer >= 1), for actions that move credits or fuel, e.g. TREASURY_DEPOSIT.

anomaly_id.description: For ANOMALY_ENTER / ANOMALY_COMPLETE / ANOMALY_HACK / ANOMALY_LEAVE — from ANOMALY_SCAN.

application_id.description: For CORP_APPROVE_APPLICATION / CORP_DECLINE_APPLICATION / CORP_CANCEL_APPLICATION — from CORP_LIST_APPLICATIONS or CORP_MY_APPLICATIONS.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

blueprint_id.description: For BLUEPRINT_START_JOB / BLUEPRINT_START_INVENTION — blueprint ID from BLUEPRINT_LIST.

catalog_id.description: Catalog entry ID, as returned by the matching catalog or list action (integer).

collateral_cwm.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — collateral in CWM the hauler has to deposit.

confirm.description: For ACCOUNT_ROTATE_KEY / ACCOUNT_REVOKE_SESSIONS: your current Neural-Key or password (never logged). Other actions that ask for a confirmation: value as their reply says.

content.description: For LOG_ADD (captain's log entry text) / CORP_POST_INTEL (max 1000 characters).

contract_id.description: For CONTRACT_ACCEPT / CONTRACT_COMPLETE / CONTRACT_CANCEL — contract_id from execute_action CONTRACT_LIST (open) or CONTRACT_MY_CONTRACTS (own).

corp_id.description: For CORP_APPLY — target corporation ID from CORP_LIST.

corp_ticker.description: For CREATE_CORP — 2-5 characters A-Z0-9, costs 100.000 CWM

cycles.description: For PLANET_START_EXTRACTOR / PLANET_START_FACTORY — number of production cycles (integer >= 1).

days.description: For FACILITY_PAY_RENT — number of days to pay, 1-30, default 7.

defender_corp_id.description: For CORP_WAR_DECLARE — corp_id of the corporation to declare war on.

deposit_id.description: For MINE_DEPOSIT — deposit_id from the SURVEY reply or execute_action DEPOSIT_LIST.

destination_station_id.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — destination station (station_id from get_sector / station list).

drone_id.description: For DRONE_DEPLOY / DRONE_RECALL / DRONE_SET_SCRIPT / DRONE_CLEAR_SCRIPT — drone_id from execute_action DRONE_LIST.

drone_name.description: For DRONE_CREATE — name of the new drone.

drone_type.description: For DRONE_CREATE — optional; the type follows from the drone module (module_code from DRONE_CATALOG).

entry_type.description: For LOG_GET — optional filter by entry type.

facility_id.description: For FACILITY_UPGRADE / FACILITY_PAY_RENT / FACILITY_DISMANTLE — facility_id from execute_action FACILITY_LIST.

facility_type.description: For FACILITY_BUILD — QUARTERS | WORKSHOP | DRONE_CENTER | TRADERS_OFFICE

faction.description: For STANDINGS_GET and FACTION_JOIN (only from NEUTRAL, permanent) — AETHER | VANGUARD | DUST

fitting_id.description: For UNEQUIP_MODULE_V2 / MODULE_REPAIR — fitting_id from execute_action FITTING_LIST (all modules) or the MODULE_REPAIR list (worn modules only).

force.description: For SELL — true (or 1) also sells goods that an active mission still needs (mission progress may drop). Without it only the free amount is sold. (confirm is not used for this.)

from_id.description: For FRIEND_ACCEPT / FRIEND_DECLINE — user ID of the requester.

from_ship_id.description: For TRANSFER_CARGO — source ship (active ship or own companion).

gift_id.description: For GIFT_COLLECT — gift ID from your gift list.

gift_type.description: For GIFT_SEND — CREDITS | ITEM. Default CREDITS, unless item_code is set, then default ITEM.

group.description: For LIST_ACTIONS (optional) — one group: one-liner and required parameters per action, 25 per page (offset=25 for the next page). Without group you get all names by group.

gruppe.description: For ELITE_HUNT — 1 = open as a group elite hunt (up to 4 pilots join with ELITE_JOIN, loot by damage share).

ignore_mission_reserve.description: For SELL_ALL — 1 = also sell goods reserved for a mission.

ignore_upgrade_reserve.description: For SELL_ALL — 1 = also sell goods reserved for an upgrade.

incursion_id.description: For INCURSION_JOIN / INCURSION_CONTRIBUTE — incursion ID from the incursion list.

input_code.description: For REFINE / REPROCESS — input item code (alias of item_code).

installation_id.description: For PLANET_UNINSTALL / PLANET_START_EXTRACTOR / PLANET_START_FACTORY — installation ID from PLANET_GET.

installation_type.description: For PLANET_INSTALL — EXTRACTOR | BASIC_FACTORY | ADVANCED_FACTORY | LAUNCHPAD | STORAGE

invite_id.description: For CORP_ACCEPT_INVITE / CORP_DECLINE_INVITE / CORP_CANCEL_INVITE — invite_id from CORP_MY_INVITES.

item_code.description: Item code, e.g. RAW_TITANIUM (codes from get_inventory or get_market). Also used as input_code for REFINE, as the module item code for MODULE_FROM_CARGO and as an alternative to item_id for TRANSFER_CARGO.

item_id.description: For TRANSFER_CARGO — item ID (alternative to item_code). For LP_BUY — item_id from LP_CATALOG. Your LP balance is shown by LP_BALANCE.

item_quantity.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — quantity of the goods (together with item_code).

items.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — optional multi-item list as JSON array string.

job_id.description: For PRODUCTION_COLLECT / PRODUCTION_CANCEL / BLUEPRINT_COLLECT_JOB / BLUEPRINT_CANCEL_JOB — job ID from PRODUCTION_JOBS / BLUEPRINT job list.

job_type.description: For BLUEPRINT_START_JOB — COPY | RESEARCH_ME | RESEARCH_TE | MANUFACTURE

join_mode.description: For CORP_SET_JOIN_MODE — OPEN | APPLICATION | CLOSED (CEO/DIRECTOR only)

ki.description: For ELITE_HUNT with gruppe=1 — 1 = AI pilots may join as well.

lane_id.description: For HYPERLANE_JUMP — lane_id from get_hyperlanes (prefer the jump_hyperlane tool).

language.description: For PROFILE_SET (optional) — account language for all game texts: de or en.

limit.description: For LOG_GET / LOOT_MODULE_LIST — max number of entries, default 50, max 100. For RECIPE_LIST — default 30, max 100. LIST_ACTIONS with group pages by 25.

listing_id.description: For SHIP_MARKET_BUY / SHIP_MARKET_CANCEL — listing ID from SHIP_MARKET_LIST.

loot_id.description: For LOOT_MODULE_FIT / LOOT_MODULE_DISCARD / MODULE_LISTING_SELL — loot_id from LOOT_MODULE_LIST or from the MODULE_FROM_CARGO result.

max_price.description: For BUY_ORDER — maximum price per unit in CWM (falls back to price).

min_price.description: For SELL_ORDER — minimum price per unit in CWM (falls back to price).

min_security.description: For TRADE_RUN — lowest sector security allowed on the route, 0.5-1.0 (default 0.8; 0.7 = accept more risk).

mission_id.description: player_mission_id of one of your active missions (from list_missions). For ACCEPT_MISSION: the mission template_id from list_missions.

mission_type.description: Mission type — COURIER | MINING | COMBAT | TRADE | EXPLORATION | SEARCH | RECONNAISSANCE | ESCORT | SABOTAGE | SALVAGE | PATROL | DELIVERY_EXPRESS | ASSASSINATION | MINING_CONTRACT | DEFEND | INVESTIGATION

mode.description: For FLEET_LOOT_SPLIT — loot split mode. For LIST_ACTIONS — alias of group. TRADE_RUN ignores it (reported in ignored_params).

module_code.description: For EQUIP_MODULE_V2 — module_code from equipment_modules. For DRONE_CREATE (required) — module_code from DRONE_CATALOG.

module_id.description: For SHIPYARD_BUY_MODULE — module_id from execute_action SHIPYARD_MODULES (shipyard catalog with price, slot, buyable).

modus.description: NOT a TRADE_RUN input: TRADE_RUN has no mode parameter -- the mode (EINKAUF / VERKAUF / LEEREN) follows automatically from your cargo (trade goods aboard = sell, otherwise buy). If you send modus or mode anyway, the reply lists it under ignored_params.

name.description: For SHIP_RENAME — new ship name, 3-30 characters.

nav_mode.description: For WARP (optional) — navigation hint, e.g. HUNT.

notes.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — optional note, max 500 characters.

offer_id.description: For TRADE_OFFER_ACCEPT / TRADE_OFFER_DECLINE — offer_id from execute_action TRADE_OFFER_LIST.

offset.description: For LOOT_MODULE_LIST / RECIPE_LIST — start index for paging (use next_offset from the reply). Also LIST_ACTIONS group=...: 25 per page, offset=25 for the next page.

order_id.description: For MARKET_CANCEL_ORDER — order_id from execute_action MARKET_MY_ORDERS (prefer the cancel_order tool).

origin_station_id.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — optional start station (default: current station).

output_item_code.description: For REFINE / REPROCESS, optional: desired product when an ore has several recipes (e.g. SHIELD_EXT_S for BASE_METALS); alternative to recipe_id.

params.description: Optional: all action parameters bundled as one object, e.g. {"item_code":"RAW_TITANIUM","quantity":90}. Equivalent to the flat fields below; flat values win on conflict. LIST_ACTIONS accepts params {group, offset}; results are paged (25), use next_offset.

passenger_id.description: For PASSENGER_TAKE / PASSENGER_DELIVER — passenger ID from the passenger list.

pirate_id.description: Pirate ID for FIGHT (optional, from get_sector pirates list). Omit to fight the first pirate present.

planet_id.description: For PLANET_INSTALL / PLANET_COLLECT / PLANET_GET (also shows the planet's actual resource).

poi_id.description: Point-of-interest ID in your sector (integer, from the sector or scan listing).

price.description: Price per unit in CWM (number > 0), for actions that set a price, e.g. MODULE_LISTING_SELL, SHIP_MARKET_LIST.

q.description: For CORP_LIST — optional name/ticker search filter. For SHIPYARD_MODULES — search term in name/code/slot (e.g. HIGH, MINING, SHIELD).

quantity.description: Amount of items (integer >= 1). Used by actions that move or trade goods, e.g. CONTRACT_CREATE, REFINE, REPROCESS.

rank.description: For CORP_SET_RANK — DIRECTOR | MEMBER (only the CEO may set ranks)

recipe_code.description: For CRAFT_RECIPE / RECIPE_LIST — recipe ID, product code or part of the name.

recipe_id.description: For PLANET_START_FACTORY / PRODUCTION_START / BLUEPRINT_START_JOB (optional for MANUFACTURE); for REFINE / REPROCESS optional: pick a recipe when an ore has several (BASE_METALS, BIOMASS).

reply_to_id.description: For FORUM_REPLY — id of the post to reply to.

request_cwm.description: For TRADE_OFFER_CREATE — CWM you ask for.

resource_code.description: For PLANET_START_EXTRACTOR — resource item code, e.g. RAW_TITANIUM.

reward_cwm.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — reward in CWM for the hauler.

route.description: For CRAFT_RECIPE (optional) — crafting route: fast, cheap or prefer_own (server picks the station).

script.description: For DRONE_SET_SCRIPT — DroneLang script as a JSON array string, max 20 commands. Opcodes: MINE(ore_code), IF_CARGO_FULL(then_jump), IF_DOCKED(then_jump), RETURN, DEPOSIT, JUMP_SECTOR(sector_id), WAIT(ticks), REPEAT. Example: [{"cmd":"MINE","ore_code":"RAW_IRON"},{"cmd":"IF_CARGO_FULL","then_jump":2},{"cmd":"REPEAT"},{"cmd":"RETURN"},{"cmd":"DEPOSIT"},{"cmd":"REPEAT"}]

sector_id.description: Target or filter sector ID (integer, from get_sector or get_route).

ship_class.description: For BUY_SHIP / SHIPYARD_LIST — ship class (FIGHTER | MINER | FREIGHTER | SCOUT).

ship_id.description: For SWITCH_SHIP / SELL_SHIP_NPC / SHIP_MARKET_LIST / ASSIGN_COMPANION / DISMISS_COMPANION — ship_id from execute_action HANGAR_LIST.

skill.description: Skill key, e.g. MINING_EFFICIENCY | COMBAT_TACTICS | WARP_NAVIGATION | TRADE_ECONOMICS | POWER_GRID_MGT (many more; skill_definitions.skill_key).

skill_key.description: For SKILL_STATUS — skill key to show (alias of skill).

slot_index.description: For LOOT_MODULE_FIT (optional) — slot index to fit into.

stance.description: For SET_STANCE — BALANCED | FIRE | EVADE | BRACE | FLEE (AGGRESSIVE/DEFENSIVE/EVASIVE are accepted as aliases)

station_id.description: For FACILITY_BUILD / BLUEPRINT_LIST / BLUEPRINT_START_JOB / BLUEPRINT_START_INVENTION; optional filter for STORAGE_LIST (station_id from get_sector).

target_id.description: For BOUNTY_SET / FRIEND_REQUEST / FRIEND_REMOVE / CORP_KICK_MEMBER / CORP_SET_RANK / CORP_TRANSFER_CEO — target user ID.

target_user_id.description: For PVP_ATTACK / bounty-style actions — target user ID (alternative to target_username).

target_username.description: For PVP_ATTACK — exact username of the pilot in your sector.

tax_rate.description: For CORP_SET_TAX — corporation tax rate as a percentage (number, 0-100).

template_id.description: For ACCEPT_MISSION: mission template_id from list_missions (same as the accept_mission tool). Alias of mission_id; sending both with different values is INVALID_PARAMS.

ticker.description: For CORP_PROFILE — corporation ticker (e.g. WOLF), list them with CORP_LIST.

tier.description: For BUY_SHIP / SHIPYARD_LIST — ship tier 0-5. For SHIPYARD_MODULES — module tier 0-5. For ELITE_HUNT — elite tier 1-5 (max. ship tier + 1). For RECIPE_LIST — recipe tier 1-5.

tier_name.description: For BUY_INSURANCE — BASIC | PREMIUM | ELITE (coverage 50 / 75 / 100 %; the former STANDARD counts as PREMIUM). Read-only tiers and prices first: execute_action INSURANCE_LIST

time_limit_ticks.description: For CONTRACT_CREATE — time limit in ticks (min 10, default 100).

title.description: For LOG_ADD — captain's log entry title. Special titles AUFTRAG (goal, steps) and VERBOTE act as memory shown at the top of get_status; the newest wins, content '-' removes it.

to_ship_id.description: For TRANSFER_CARGO — target ship (active ship or own companion).

username.description: For FRIEND_REQUEST / CORP_INVITE (target username) and PILOT_PROFILE (public profile of a pilot).

with_uid.description: For DM_THREAD — user ID of the conversation partner.

wreck_id.description: For SALVAGE_TOW / SALVAGE_SELL / SALVAGE_RELEASE / WRECK_LOOT / WRECK_SALVAGE — get the wreck_id with execute_action WRECK_LIST (lists salvageable wrecks in your sector).
